title: Tune or prompt? Build the tuning set and pick a model with numbers
scenario: Course Ops wrote 309 quiz items in the house style and asked whether a tuned Flash-Lite can replace prompted Flash. Recorded outputs exist for three candidates on a 50-item held-out set. Build the supervised tuning dataset (format, duplicates, leakage, split) and the comparison that decides what ships.
task: Dedupe, leakage check and a deterministic hash split with a report
Strict output parsing, correctness, grounding, cost per 1,000 and latency percentiles
A decision rule and a written recommendation
acceptance: Exact dataset counts and order-independent split
Scores match the reference for all candidates

practices.label: Week 6 Mon - when tuning beats prompting and RAG
Week 6 Wed - comparing candidates on one eval set
